Publish the working copy's new and modified components as new catalog versions, which the server
builds from their src/**.rs and Cargo.toml.

Newer catalog versions are merged into the working copy first, as 'voidhash dev' does; a component
with conflicts cannot be published until they are resolved. The command waits for every build and
fails when one did not build.

On a terminal it asks which components to publish; anywhere else, pass --all or --component. With
--json it prints the published versions, with -q their ids.

Usage:
  voidhash publish [flags]

Flags:
      --all               Publish every new and modified component
      --component <slug>  Publish this component, by its slug (can be repeated)
  -h, --help              Show help for this command
      --json              Print the API objects as JSON, for scripts
  -q, --quiet             Print only ids, one per line
  -y, --yes               Publish without asking for confirmation

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash publish
  voidhash publish --all --yes
  voidhash publish --component sale-badge --component wheel-picker
